pin_title: 6 Christmas Decorations Under £25 UK Homes Love This Year
pin_title_alt: 3 Easy Ways to Make Your Living Room Feel Christmassy
pin_hook: Classic, cosy decor that doesn't break the budget
pin_description: Christmas decorations under £25 that UK homes love: baubles, fairy lights, a gold star tree topper, personalised stockings and festive cushion covers. Easy Christmas decorating ideas for the tree, mantel and living room. #ad #christmasdecor #christmashome #ukchristmas
intro: Decking the halls doesn't need to cost a fortune - here are six well-loved Christmas decorations UK shoppers keep coming back to.

products.name: SHareconn 106pcs Christmas Baubles
products.headline: Fill the whole tree in one go
products.why: A big, coordinated set of red and gold baubles in mixed sizes so the tree looks professionally styled without buying several smaller packs.

products.name: ANSIO Christmas Lights 100 LED 10m
products.headline: Instant cosy glow, mains powered
products.why: A reliable, well-reviewed set of warm white lights that works for the tree, mantel or window without batteries to replace.

products.name: Gisela Graham Gold Star Tree Topper
products.headline: Finish the tree off properly
products.why: A classic glitter star from a trusted British decorations brand that dresses up even a simple tree.

products.name: Hoolaroo Personalised Christmas Stocking
products.headline: A stocking that feels extra special
products.why: Custom name embroidery and a satin lining make this feel like a proper heirloom stocking rather than a throwaway one.

products.name: FengRise Christmas Cushion Covers Set of 4
products.headline: An easy sofa refresh for December
products.why: Slip these over your existing cushions for an instant festive living room without buying new cushions outright.

products.headline: Festive scents without the splurge
products.why: A soy wax candle set with a mix of seasonal scents, handy for gifting or dotting around the house for that just-lit-the-tree smell.
